title: Wiretap: fix compile-time error using a macro
description:
As per [1], !9596 caused compile-time errors on MSVC. Rather than add
typecasts and resulting friction to the function calls, I created a
macro for the common use case of adding a null-terminated string to the
Exported PDU data being generated, which handles the typecasting.

[1]: https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9596#note_1313094159

notes.body: I've added a fixed version of those changes to !10048.
Cool then, I guess we won't need this MR in that case.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -2224,6 +2224,19 @@ gboolean wtap_dump_can_write(const GArray *file_encaps, guint32 required_comment
 WS_DLL_PUBLIC
 void wtap_buffer_append_epdu_tag(Buffer *buf, guint16 epdu_tag, guint8 *data, guint16 data_len);
 
+/**
+ * Generates null-terminated string data in "exported PDU" format
+ * and appends it to buf.
+ * (Really just a readability wrapper around
+ * wtap_buffer_append_epdu_tag().)
+ *
+ * @param[in,out] buf   Buffer into which to write field
+ * @param epdu_tag      tag ID of field to create
+ * @param str           null-terminated string to be written
+ */
+#define wtap_buffer_append_epdu_str(buf, epdu_tag, str) \
+    wtap_buffer_append_epdu_tag(buf, epdu_tag, (guint8 *)str, (guint16)strlen(str))
+
 /**
  * Generates packet data for an unsigned integer in "exported PDU" format.
  * For filetype readers to transform non-packetized data.

commits_data.message:
Wiretap: fix compile-time error using a macro

As per [1], !9596 caused compile-time errors on MSVC. Rather than add
typecasts and resulting friction to the function calls, I created a
macro for the common use case of adding a null-terminated string to the
Exported PDU data being generated, which handles the typecasting.

[1]: https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9596#note_1313094159
